title: Strict-local model comparison for projective-line stalk exchange
statement: For the projective-line pullback square and integral geometric points of the reduction theorem, strict henselian local rings and a local map between them, a restricted torsion sheaf, source and target stalk additive equivalences, and residue cohomology additive equivalences exist and commute with the stalk exchange and cohomology pullback maps.

source.place: proof of Theorem Tag 095T, paragraphs 3--4; strict-henselization stalk comparison

proof.text: Strict henselization at compatible geometric points and its functoriality give the local rings, local map, and restricted torsion sheaf.
The strict-henselization stalk formula and termwise exchange comparison give stalk equivalences and the exchange compatibility.
Topological invariance and cohomology functoriality give residue equivalences and compatibility of the cohomology pullback.
